instruction.name: vsllwil.h.b
instruction.description: For each 128-bit lane, sign-extend and shift the 8-bit elements in the lower part of that lane by `imm` to 16-bit result.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 2.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
